description: Change any field of a recipe or draft the user owns or may edit. Only fields you pass change; lists you pass replace the old ones. Every edit is saved as a new revision (undo with restore_revision). To resize permanently, pass scale_to_servings or scale_factor; for a one-off view use get_recipe. Filing fields are owner-only. Blocked on read-only accounts. Returns the updated recipe.

change_summary.description: Short history note, max 300 chars, e.g. "Less salt"

description.description: One or two sentences about the dish, max 2000 chars

diet.description: Diet labels only as the user stated them, e.g. ["Vegetarian"]

family_group_id.description: Group id (from manage_family list) when visibility is family

id.description: Recipe id (UUID) from search_recipes or an earlier result

ingredients.description: Lines like "2 cups flour, sifted" or {quantity, unit, item, note, group}; replaces the whole list

main_ingredient.description: Main ingredient, same values as save_recipe

method.description: Cooking methods, same values as save_recipe

scale_factor.description: Permanently multiply all amounts, e.g. 0.5 or 2

scale_to_servings.description: Permanently rescale all amounts to this many servings, e.g. 8

servings.description: Number of servings the amounts make, e.g. 4 (default 4 on save)

source_url.description: Original web page URL, if any

steps.description: Strings or {text, timer_minutes, temp_f}; replaces the whole list

title.description: Dish name, max 200 chars, e.g. "Lemon Garlic Chicken"

visibility.description: private = only the user; family = shared with family_group_id. Default: the user's sharing default

name: update_recipe
title: Edit a recipe or draft
